name: Sunrise Efficient Marketing Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2020, Sunrise Efficient 
Marketing Ltd trading and distribution 
of industrials and electronic components[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SEML provides energy-efficient products and automation solutions to its customers. They serve as stockiest, dealer, channel partners for various companies for stocks of IE 2 and IE 3 grade Induction motors, power transmission products such as worm and helical gears boxes, LED lighting fittings, Lubricants viz. Hydraulic oil, gear oil, thermic fluid, industrial pumps, chemical pumps. It has recently started the Drives and Automation division and is converting and updating machines with automation products. Company has started keeping servo motors and Servo drivers in stock to meet the needs of the manufacturer

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -2.25%
Debtor days have increased from 87.1 to 116 days.
